name: Inclement Idée Fixe
source:
It's a typical workday for you as a barista at your local cafe, or at least it was supposed to be. Upon arriving at work and seeing that it's closed for renovations, you begin your aggravated walk back home, only to run right into a rainstorm. With a stranger being your only way home, to avoid getting drenched and/or sick, you have no choice but to walk with him...

[From [url=https://himebee.itch.io/inclement-idee-fixe]itch.io[/url]]
